from collections import defaultdict
N = 100
states = {(4, 1, 2, 3): 1.0}

while states:

    for (next_ball, a, b, c), prob in states.items():
        for piston in (1, 2, 3):
            p = prob / 3.0
            if piston == 1:
                if a:
                    ejected[a] += p
                vals = (b, c, next_ball if next_ball <= N else 0)

            elif piston == 2:
                if b:
                    ejected[b] += p
                vals = (c, next_ball if next_ball <= N else 0,
                        next_ball + 1 if next_ball + 1 <= N else 0)
                nb = next_ball + 2
            else:
                if c:
                    ejected[c] += p
                vals = (b, next_ball if next_ball <= N else 0,
                        next_ball + 1 if next_ball + 1 <= N else 0)
                nb = next_ball + 2
            if any(vals):
                nxt[(nb, *vals)] += p
    states = nxt
maximum = max(ejected[1:])
winners = [i for i in range(1, N + 1) if abs(ejected[i] - maximum) < 1e-12]
print(maximum)
print(winners)
print([(i, round(ejected[i], 12)) for i in range(1, 21)])
PY""")
